basic_details.job_title: WCCB Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 12 Driver, Head Constable and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Wildlife Crime Control Bureau (WCCB), under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India, has released the WCCB Recruitment 2026 notification for 12 vacancies across various posts, including Assistant Director, Public Prosecutor, Inspector, Stenographer, Head Constable, Driver, and others. Eligible candidates can apply for these posts on a deputation basis by submitting their applications through email and post. The last date for submission of applications is 31 October 2026. The available pay scales range from Level 2 to Level 10 of the 7th Central Pay Commissio

faq.answer: Applications must be submitted by post to the Assistant Director (Admin) at the New Delhi address and by email to [email protected].
